title: Provider
description: A statistical provider's stable identity and descriptive information. Adapter configuration belongs outside this document, including outside extension.

code.description: Stable provider identity, independent of display names and adapters. Other documents reference this value as provider_code.

label.description: Display names. Available translations do not declare adapter language support.

description.description: Descriptions of the provider in Swedish, English, or both.

country_code.description: Two uppercase letters identifying the provider's home country, not dataset coverage. Assigned-country membership is not checked.

website.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URI with a host. Consumers must enable URI format validation.

extension.description: Additional descriptive information; arbitrary JSON values are allowed. Do not store adapter settings here.
